says: In today's lead tooling, the tests, build and review skills tell a step to push with botpush.mjs, which refuses every cloud commit ('botpush: no refs/notes/fabrika here; sign the commits before pushing') because decisions 0161 and 0164 make cloud commits plain and unsigned.
proof: botpush.mjs:111 throws when refs/notes/fabrika is absent; .agents/skills/tests/SKILL.md:177, .agents/skills/build/SKILL.md:105 and .agents/skills/review/SKILL.md:146 name botpush.mjs as the push; on PR 1588 the tests step and the review step both hit the refusal and the lead pushed with a plain git push.
cost: Every cloud step stops at its push, or an agent improvises a push the skill does not name.
